n: Model AI Assignments: A Fresh Squeeze on Data
t: A grade 3 to 5 lesson on data bias using a lemonade stand story.
steps: Find the Model AI Assignments page for A Fresh Squeeze on Data.
Download the lesson plan PDF and the story PDF.
Open Teachable Machine and label the classes for the lesson.
Train the model before class and test it.
Prepare Google Docs for the data visualization step.
Read the story aloud or share it with students.
